chapter.h1: THE FIRST EPISTLE GENERAL OF JOHN
chapter.li: LEChapter1 Verse1 Brethren, this is the testimony which we give of that which was from the beginning — which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon and our hands have handled — of the Word of Life. VerseEnd (Verse2 For the Life was manifested, and we have seen it and bear witness, and show unto you that eternal life which was with the Father and was manifested unto us. VerseEnd) Verse3 That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that you also may have fellowship with us; and truly our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ. VerseEnd Verse4 And these things write we unto you that your joy may be full. VerseEnd

Verse5 This then is the message which we have heard of him and declare unto you: that God is light, and in him there is no darkness at all. VerseEnd Verse6 If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth. VerseEnd Verse7 But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin. VerseEnd

Verse8 If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves and the truth is not in us. VerseEnd Verse9 If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. VerseEnd Verse10 If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar and his word is not in us. VerseEnd

LEChapter2 Verse1 My little children, these things write I unto you that you sin not. But if any man sin and repent, we have an advocate with the Father: Jesus Christ the Righteous. VerseEnd Verse2 And he is the propitiation for our sins — and not for ours only, but also for the sins of the whole world. VerseEnd

Verse3 And hereby we do know that we know him: if we keep his commandments. VerseEnd Verse4 He that says, I know him, and keeps not his commandments, is a liar and the truth is not in him. VerseEnd Verse5 But whoever keeps his word, in him truly is the love of God perfected; hereby know we that we are in him. VerseEnd Verse6 He that says he abides in him ought himself also to walk even as he walked. VerseEnd

Verse7 Brethren, I write a new commandment unto you, but it is the same commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you have heard from the beginning. VerseEnd Verse8 Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing was of old ordained of God, and is true in him and in you, because the darkness is past in you and the true light now shines. VerseEnd Verse9 He that says he is in the light and hates his brother is in darkness even until now. VerseEnd Verse10 He that loves his brother abides in the light and there is no stumbling block in him. VerseEnd Verse11 But he that hates his brother is in darkness, and walks in darkness, and knows not where he goes because that darkness has blinded his eyes. VerseEnd

Verse12 I write unto you little children because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake. VerseEnd Verse13 I write unto you fathers because you have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you young men because you have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you little children because you have known the Father. VerseEnd Verse14 I have written unto you fathers because you have known him from the beginning. I have written unto you young men because you are strong, and the word of God abides in you, and you have overcome the wicked one. VerseEnd

Verse15 Love not the world, neither the things that are of the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him; VerseEnd Verse16 for all in the world that is of the lusts of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world. VerseEnd Verse17 And the world passes away, and the lust thereof; but he that does the will of God abides for ever. VerseEnd

Verse18 Little children, it is the last time, and as you have heard that antichrist shall come, even now there are many antichrists, whereby we know that it is the last time. VerseEnd Verse19 They went out from us, but they were not of us, for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us, but they went out that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us. VerseEnd

Verse20 But you have an anointing from the Holy One, and you know all things. VerseEnd Verse21 I have not written unto you because you know not the truth, but because you know it, and that no lie is of the truth. VerseEnd Verse22 Who is a liar but he that denies that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist that denies the Father and the Son. VerseEnd Verse23 Whoever denies the Son, the same has not the Father. VerseEnd Verse24 Let that therefore abide in you which you have heard from the beginning. If that which you have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, you also shall continue in the Son and in the Father, VerseEnd Verse25 and this is the promise that he has promised us, even eternal life. VerseEnd

Verse26 These things have I written unto you concerning those who seduce you, VerseEnd Verse27 but the anointing which you have received of him abides in you, and you need not any man to teach you. But as the same anointing teaches you of all things (and is truth and is no lie), and even as it has taught you, you shall abide in him. VerseEnd

Verse28 And now, little children, abide in him, that when he shall appear, we may have confidence and not be ashamed before him at his coming. VerseEnd Verse29 If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone that does righteousness is born of him. VerseEnd

LEChapter3 Verse1 Behold what manner of love the Father has bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God. Therefore, the world knows us not, because it knew him not. VerseEnd Verse2 Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it does not yet appear what we shall be; but we know that when he shall appear, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is. VerseEnd Verse3 And every man that has this hope in him purifies himself, even as he is pure. VerseEnd

Verse4 Whoever commits sin transgresses also the law, for sin is the transgression of the law. VerseEnd Verse5 And you know that he was manifested to take away our sins, and in him is no sin. VerseEnd Verse6 Whoever abides in him sins not. Whoever continues in sin has not seen him, neither known him. VerseEnd Verse7 Little children, let no man deceive you. He that does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous. VerseEnd Verse8 He that continues in sin is of the Devil, for the Devil sins from the beginning. For this purpose, the Son of God was manifested: that he might destroy the works of the Devil. VerseEnd Verse9 Whoever is born of God does not continue in sin, for the spirit of God remains in him, and he cannot continue in sin because he is born of God, having received that Holy Spirit of Promise. VerseEnd Verse10 In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the Devil. Whoever does not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loves not his brother, VerseEnd Verse11 for this is the message that you heard from the beginning: that we should love one another, VerseEnd Verse12 not as Cain, who was of that wicked one and slew his brother. And why did he slay him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous. VerseEnd

Verse13 Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you. VerseEnd Verse14 We know that we have passed from death unto life because we love the brethren. He that loves not his brother abides in death. VerseEnd Verse15 Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him. VerseEnd Verse16 Hereby perceive we the love of Christ, because he laid down his life for us, and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren. VerseEnd Verse17 But whoever has this world’s goods, and sees his brother has need, and shuts up his heart of compassion from him, how does the love of God dwell in him? VerseEnd

Verse18 My little children, let us not love in word, neither in tongue only, but in deed and in truth. VerseEnd Verse19 And hereby we know that we are of the truth and shall assure our hearts before him, VerseEnd Verse20 for if our hearts condemn us, God is greater than our heart and knows all things. VerseEnd Verse21 Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then we have confidence toward God. VerseEnd Verse22 And whatever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments and do those things that are pleasing in his sight. VerseEnd

Verse23 And this is his commandment: that we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment. VerseEnd Verse24 And he that keeps his commandments dwells in him, and he in them. And hereby we know that he abides in us: by the spirit which he has given us. VerseEnd

LEChapter4 Verse1 Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits — whether they are of God — because many false prophets are gone out into the world. VerseEnd Verse2 Hereby know you the spirit of God: every spirit that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God, VerseEnd Verse3 and every spirit that confesses not that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God, and this is that spirit of antichrist whereof you have heard that it should come; and even now it is already in the world. VerseEnd Verse4 You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he that is in you than he that is in the world. VerseEnd Verse5 They are of the world, therefore speak they of the world and the world hears them. VerseEnd Verse6 We are of God. He that knows God hears us. He that is not of God hears not us. Hereby know we the spirit of truth and the spirit of error. VerseEnd

Verse7 Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God, and everyone that loves is born of God and knows God. VerseEnd Verse8 He that loves not knows not God, for God is love. VerseEnd Verse9 In this was manifested the love of God toward us: because God sent his Only Begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him. VerseEnd Verse10 Herein is love: not that we loved God, but that he loved us and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins. VerseEnd Verse11 Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another. VerseEnd Verse12 No man has seen God at any time except those who believe. If we love one another, God dwells in us and his love is perfected in us. VerseEnd Verse13 Hereby know we that we dwell in him and he in us: because he has given us of his spirit. VerseEnd

Verse14 And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Savior of the world. VerseEnd Verse15 Whoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwells in him and he in God. VerseEnd Verse16 And we have known and believed the love that God has to us. God is love, and he that dwells in love dwells in God, and God in him. VerseEnd Verse17 Herein is our love made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world. VerseEnd Verse18 There is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has torment. He that fears is not made perfect in love. VerseEnd Verse19 We love him because he first loved us. VerseEnd Verse20 If a man say, I love God, and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he that loves not his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen? VerseEnd Verse21 And this commandment have we from him: that he who loves God loves his brother also. VerseEnd

LEChapter5 Verse1 Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God, and everyone that loves him that begot loves him also that is begotten of him. VerseEnd Verse2 By this we know that we love the children of God: when we love God and keep his commandments, VerseEnd Verse3 for this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments.

And his commandments are not grievous, VerseEnd Verse4 for whatever is born of God overcomes the world. And this is the victory that overcomes the world, even our faith. VerseEnd Verse5 Who is he that overcomes the world but he that believes that Jesus is the Son of God? VerseEnd Verse6 This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ — not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the spirit that bears witness, because the spirit is truth, VerseEnd Verse7 for there are three that bear record in Heaven: the Father, the Word, and the holy ghost; and these three are agreed as one. VerseEnd Verse8 And there are three that bear witness in earth: the spirit, and the water, and the blood; and these three agree in one. VerseEnd Verse9 If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater, for this is the witness of God which he has testified of his Son. VerseEnd

Verse10 He that believes on the Son of God has the witness in himself. He that believes not God has made him a liar, because he believes not the record that God gave of his Son. VerseEnd Verse11 And this is the record: that God has given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son. VerseEnd Verse12 He that has the Son has life, and he that has not the Son of God has not life. VerseEnd

Verse13 These things I have written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe on the name of the Son of God. VerseEnd Verse14 And this is the confidence that we have in him: that if we ask anything according to his will, he hears us. VerseEnd Verse15 And if we know that he hear us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him. VerseEnd

Verse16 If any man sees his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death; I do not say that he shall pray for it. VerseEnd Verse17 All unrighteousness is sin, and there is a sin not unto death. VerseEnd Verse18 We know that whoever is born of God continues not in sin, but he that is begotten of God and keeps himself, that wicked one overcomes him not. VerseEnd Verse19 And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in wickedness, VerseEnd Verse20 and we know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true; and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life. VerseEnd
Verse21 Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen. VerseEnd
